subject: Re: PO routing & monthly-close alignment for Acme Supplies
messages:
From: Tomas Reed <tomas@acmesupplies.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: billing@acmesupplies.com
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO routing & monthly-close alignment?

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're getting set up on a few new vendor portals and need to confirm how Redwood wants invoices routed and which cutoff we should plan around so our month-end and yours don't get out of sync. A few specifics from our side:

- We close our billing month on the last calendar day and typically pay on Net60 by default for smaller vendors.
- Our AP team needs the PO number on the invoice and for invoices to be sent to billing@acmesupplies.com and also to be uploaded to your portal if available.
- We can provide a PO for recurring spend; can you confirm the PO field Redwood expects (billing code, project tag, or company PO)?

We'd prefer Net45 or Net60 if possible — is Redwood open to those terms for new vendors? Also curious if you offer any early-pay options or discounts (we'd evaluate).

I've attached our W-9 and a sample invoice for reference.

Thanks,
Tomas Reed
Head of Billing Operations
Acme Supplies
attachments: w9_acmesupplies.pdf, acme_sample_invoice.pdf

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tomas Reed <tomas@acmesupplies.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO routing & monthly-close alignment?

Hi Tomas — great to hear from you and thanks for sending the W-9 and sample invoice. I'm looping in Procurement (Marissa) and Finance (Laura) so we can align on the PO + cutoff rules. High level: we typically onboard vendors on Net30, but for enterprise partners we can accommodate Net45 or Net60 if Finance signs off and we have the PO and vendor onboarding complete.

Quick proposal/options from Redwood:

- Standard: Net30, invoices to ap@redwood.com with PO in the "PO#" field on the header.
- Flexible: Net45 — accepted for onboarding with completed vendor form and vendor portal setup; payment schedule aligned to our monthly close (see below).
- Extended: Net60 — requires approvals and creates a longer payment lead time; we handle on a case-by-case basis.

Early-pay option: our Treasury team offers an early-pay program (1.5% discount) if Acme elects to move invoices from Net45 to Net15 within the program window. I can share the enrollment details if that's of interest.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Please complete the attached Redwood vendor onboarding form and return with vendor tax ID and remittance instructions. (attached: redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf)
2) Confirm the exact PO metadata you will put on invoices (example: PO#, project-code, cost-center).
3) Let us know whether you want to opt into early-pay terms (we'll provide enrollment link).

Procurement / Finance — Marissa and Laura, can you confirm whether Net45 is acceptable for initial setup and what the invoice cutoff should be to land in the same month for Redwood's monthly close?

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call if helpful.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, Tomas Reed <tomas@acmesupplies.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO routing & monthly-close alignment?

Karthik / Tomas — looping in Procurement formally. We can accept Net45 as an onboarding term for Acme provided the following are completed:

- Signed vendor onboarding form with legal name and tax ID (we need exact EIN).
- PO issued on the Redwood PO template (we will send a blank template if Acme wants).
- Invoices submitted no later than the 28th of the month (or second business day before month-end) to ensure inclusion in Redwood's month close. Any invoices received after the cutoff will be processed the following month.

Marissa (procurement) note: Net60 is possible but will require Finance approval and accounting to adjust cash forecasts — prefer Net45 initially to avoid a delayed close for both sides.

Tomas, can you resend a sample invoice with the PO number populated so we can confirm the mapping? Also need remittance instructions (bank ACH details) and a contact for PO exceptions.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Tomas Reed <tomas@acmesupplies.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, billing@acmesupplies.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO routing & monthly-close alignment?

Hi Marissa / Karthik — thanks for the clear options and the onboarding form.

We can accept Net45 for the initial period and will populate the PO# field on our invoices. Attached is a sample invoice with PO# 46219 populated and our remittance instructions. Our accounting team can also sign the onboarding doc — I'll complete and return the vendor form by EOD.

We would like the early-pay enrollment details (1.5%) — please send the DocuSign link for the program and any brief T&Cs. If possible, please also send the Redwood PO template so we can ensure formatting matches your portal.

Thanks,
Tomas Reed
Head of Billing Operations
Acme Supplies
attachments: acme_sample_invoice_PO46219.pdf
